verdict.rationale: Requesty's documented Fallback Policies retry a failed request against a different model. If the primary model fails (timeout, rate limit, error), the router immediately tries the next model in a configured chain, so applications stay up when individual providers have issues. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the fallback chain is configured (UI/API fields, cross-provider ordering options), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can configure automatic fallback to another model or provider when one fails

citations.quote: Fallback Policies automatically retry your requests with different models if one fails, ensuring your application stays reliable even when individual providers have issues.
If it fails (timeout, rate limit, error, etc.), the router immediately tries the next model in the chain.
